question:
Which of the following letter-clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

DBK, GDL, JFM, MHN, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- 

 
• First letter → (3) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series. 
 
• Second letter → (2) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series. 
 
• Third letter → (1) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

​​So,

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/feb95a5d5caf72627f8f36948001e3c98f08118eb969368a355e22d75ed68e2d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**PJO**".
